labor.task: Shop fabrication - template, cut, edge, laminate all HPDL countertops, backsplash, sidesplash, reception surfaces
Field installation - countertops, brackets, grommets, sealant, scribing, fitting, leveling
Submittals, templates, color selections, certified payroll, coordination

scope.title: P-Lam Countertops (Sec 12 3200 Sec 2.05)
scope.text: Furnish and install HPDL countertops (48 LF) with 4" backsplash and sidesplash where shown, Rakks EH Series aluminum brackets, and metal cable management grommets over all base cabinets. AWI Custom Grade, HPDL per NEMA LD 3.

scope.title: Reception Counter Surfaces
scope.text: Furnish and install countertop surfaces for dual-height reception counter (35.25" service height / 34" ADA work surface). HPDL to match base cabinet P-Lam selections.

exclusions: Base cabinets, wall cabinets, and all casework boxes (by casework subcontractor).
Reception counter box/frame construction (by casework subcontractor).
Finish carpentry and White Oak items.
Silicone sealant at wall junctions (included in this scope per Spec 12 3200 Sec 2.08).
assumptions: 48 LF of countertop per plan takeoff. Reception surfaces measured as lump sum per plan detail.
Rakks EH Series brackets at 1 per 2 LF (24 total). Final bracket count subject to structural loading.
Casework boxes installed and level before countertop installation begins.
Single mobilization assumed. GC coordinates access and staging.
All work subject to King County prevailing wages. Certified payroll included.
